clear_all.description: With clear, also remove user-created breakpoints.

script_path.description: Script path; required for set and remove.

enabled.description: Initial enabled state; defaults to true.

log_message.description: Luau expressions to log; quote literal text.

continue_execution.description: Continue after hit; defaults true; false needs a resumer.

target.description: Edit, server, or client-N; defaults to edit.

tools.name: get_connected_instances
tools.description: Use to discover standalone Studio Instances and role-suffixed temporary Instances nested within multiplayer groups.

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Use to check, await, or recover a retained Studio operation.

request_id.description: Caller operation ID or request ID from a server error.

wait_ms.description: Max ms to await settlement; never cancels.

tools.name: search_assets
tools.description: Use to find public Creator Store assets by type or keyword.

assetType.description: Asset type; Image maps to Decal, Particle and VFX to Model.

query.description: Terms; Particle and VFX add an effect suffix.

robloxCreatedOnly.description: Only Roblox-created assets; defaults to false.

tools.name: get_asset_details
tools.description: Use to inspect a shortlisted Creator Store asset.

tools.name: get_asset_thumbnail
tools.description: Use when an asset thumbnail would help with visual review.

tools.name: insert_asset
tools.description: Use to sanitize and insert a Creator Store asset into a Studio place.

operation_id.description: Unique recovery ID; reuse only for identical arguments.

position.description: World position for the inserted asset.

tools.name: generate_model
tools.description: Use to stage a Roblox model from text or an image.

operation_id.description: Unique recovery ID; reuse only for identical arguments.

async.description: Return job status before generation ends.

prompt.description: Generation prompt; required without an image.

image_path.description: Local PNG; excludes other image inputs.

image_base64.description: PNG base64; image/png required; single source.

image_asset_id.description: Roblox image ID; excludes other image inputs.

schema.description: Part layout; Body1 is one mesh, Car5 is five vehicle parts.

max_triangles.description: Triangle cap; lower values are more faceted.

timeout_ms.description: Bridge deadline in ms; never cancels generation.

tools.name: preview_asset
tools.description: Use to inspect an asset's hierarchy and media without inserting it.

maxDepth.description: Displayed depth; result caps at 100 nodes, but all are scanned.

includeAudio.description: Return inline audio; needs legacy-asset:manage and never writes…

maxAudioPreviews.description: Inline audio limit; byte caps still apply.

tools.name: upload_asset
tools.description: Use to upload a local asset file to a Roblox user or group.

assetType.description: Upload type; must match the file.

userId.description: Creator user ID; replaces env defaults (groupId wins if both)

groupId.description: Creator group ID; replaces env defaults and wins over userId

tools.name: capture_screenshot
tools.description: Use to capture the Studio viewport or map input coordinates.

format.description: Format; jpeg is smaller, png lossless; default jpeg.

quality.description: JPEG quality 1-100; defaults to 92. Ignored for png.

tools.name: manage_monetization
tools.description: Use to list, inspect, create, or update developer products and game passes.

action.description: Operation; create and update change live Roblox items.

universe_id.description: Universe ID; defaults to the connected Studio place.

id.description: Product or pass ID; required for get and update.

managed_pricing.description: Let Roblox price optimization set the price.

image_path.description: Local PNG, JPEG, or BMP icon file.

tools.name: manage_experience
tools.description: Use to read or change experience settings such as title, devices, and private servers.

action.description: Operation; update changes the live game.

universe_id.description: Universe ID; defaults to the connected Studio place.

place_id.description: Place to read or edit; defaults to the root place.

name.description: Place name; the experience title on the root place.

description.description: Place description; the experience description on the root.

voice_chat_enabled.description: Allow voice chat; running servers keep their setting.

private_server_price.description: Robux price; cancels subscriptions; needs confirm.

disable_private_servers.description: true turns private servers off; needs confirm.

social_links.description: Social links to add or replace.

confirm.description: Required for private server price changes.

tools.name: simulate_mouse_input
tools.description: Use to click, move, or scroll a live playtest viewport.

action.description: Mouse action; click performs down, then up.

target.description: Peer; prefers a running client, then edit.

tools.name: simulate_keyboard_input
tools.description: Use to send key presses or text to a live playtest client.

keyCode.description: Enum.KeyCode name; omit when using text.

action.description: Key action; tap presses, waits, and releases. Defaults to tap.

duration.description: Tap hold in seconds; defaults to 0.1.

text.description: Text for the focused TextBox; excludes keyCode and action.

target.description: Peer; prefers a running client, then edit.

tools.name: get_memory_breakdown
tools.description: Use to compare memory categories across Studio peers.

target.description: Edit, server, client-N, or all; defaults to all.

tags.description: DeveloperMemoryTag filter; unknown tags return zero.

tools.name: get_scene_analysis
tools.description: Use to attribute scene cost across instances and content.

target.description: Edit, server, client-N, or all; defaults to all.

topN.description: Flattened entries per mode; defaults to 10.

raw.description: Include full nested result trees; defaults to false.

tools.name: export_rbxm
tools.description: Use to save selected DataModel instances as a local .rbxm file.

target.description: Source DataModel; defaults to edit. server reads live state.

tools.name: import_rbxm
tools.description: Use to load a local, remote, or inline .rbxm under a chosen parent.

operation_id.description: Unique recovery ID; reuse only for identical arguments.

source.description: Exactly one path, URL, or base64 source. All inputs are capped…

parent_path.description: Canonical parent path for imported instances.

target.description: Destination DataModel; defaults to edit. server uses live state.

tools.name: find_and_replace_in_scripts
tools.description: Use to preview or apply one replacement across scripts.

operation_id.description: Unique recovery ID; reuse only for identical arguments.

replacement.description: Replacement; Lua patterns support %1, %2, and so on.

caseSensitive.description: Literal match casing; patterns require true.

dryRun.description: Preview diffs and revisions without edits; defaults to false.

maxReplacements.description: Total cap checked before any write; defaults to 1000.

expected_revisions.description: Script path to revision; pass the dryRun revisions.

tools.name: get_roblox_skills
tools.description: Use to read installed Roblox Studio Assistant skills.

action.description: List skills or get one document.

name.description: Listed skill name; required for get.

tools.name: get_roblox_docs
tools.description: Use to read official Roblox engine or Luau references.

name.description: Exact engine or Luau reference name; case-sensitive.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List every design/taste skill bundled by this MCP (id + name + whenToUse + section ids). Use FIRST to discover skills; then `get_skill_section` to drill in.

tools.name: list_primitives
tools.description: List every @godxjp/ui primitive/composite/shell (group + tagline per entry). Optionally filter by group. Then `get_component` for one's full API. Core only by default — pass tier="lab" for the opt-in @godxjp/ui/lab components.

tier.description: Default "core". "lab" lists the opt-in `@godxjp/ui/lab` components (niche, kept and tested, not in the default context); "all" lists both.

tools.name: list_utilities
tools.description: List every NON-component public export of @godxjp/ui — hooks, helper functions and constants (cn, formatDate, formatCurrency, toast, useDebouncedValue, buttonVariants, CHART_COLORS, SHOW_PARENT …). Reach for this before hand-writing a className merger, a date/money formatter, a debounce hook or a chart palette: two products in this org each re-implemented `cn` because it could not be found. Optionally filter by kind. Then `get_component name="<name>"` for its signature, usage and example.

kind.description: hook = only legal inside a component body; function = callable anywhere; value = a constant to read.

tools.name: list_patterns
tools.description: List every canonical copy-paste code pattern (signup-form, settings-page, data-table-page, async-data-state, confirm-destructive, …); common aliases resolve too. Use before `get_pattern`.

tools.name: list_anti_ai_tells
tools.description: List every AI-tell pattern to AVOID (optionally by category). Use to self-audit a design before shipping; then `get_anti_ai_tell` for the fix.

tools.name: list_redesign_checks
tools.description: List the redesign audit checklist (50+ checks; optionally by category). Use when auditing an existing project; then `get_redesign_check` for a symptom's fix.

tools.name: list_audit_rules
tools.description: List the LOCAL static ui-audit rules (scripts/ui-audit.mjs) to run BEFORE any visual review — each cites the standard it enforces (WCAG/WAI-ARIA/Intl/ISO/IANA/CSS-Logical) + a fix + the run command. Optionally by category.

tools.name: list_visual_checks
tools.description: List the RUNTIME visual-audit checks (scripts/visual-audit.mjs — Playwright + axe-core) to run against the RUNNING app: contrast/ARIA (axe), target size, rendered-accent chroma, DOM emoji, banner layout. Needs a browser (vs list_audit_rules, static). Optionally by category.

tools.name: get_anti_ai_tell
tools.description: Fetch ONE anti-AI-tell — full body + concrete fix. Use after `list_anti_ai_tells`.

tools.name: get_redesign_check
tools.description: Fetch redesign check(s) matching a symptom snippet. Returns full fix + UI note. Use after `list_redesign_checks`.

symptom.description: Fragment of the symptom text (e.g. 'Inter everywhere' / '100vh').

tools.name: get_skill_section
tools.description: Fetch ONE section of ONE skill — token-efficient. E.g. `skill='soft', section='double-bezel'`. Use after `list_skills` narrowed the relevant skill + section.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Full guide for one @godxjp/ui component — import path, props/types/defaults, HOW to use it (DO/DON'T), WHEN to reach for it (use cases), related components (don't reinvent/confuse), a copy-paste example, story path, and cardinal rules. Use this before hand-rolling anything. Design-token knobs are listed compactly (name+default); pass `verbose:true` for what each token controls.

verbose.description: Include the full design-token table with a 'what it controls' description per token. Default false (compact token+default only) to save context.

tools.name: get_pattern
tools.description: Full code snippet for one canonical pattern — copy-paste-ready.

tools.name: get_rule
tools.description: Read one cardinal rule from CLAUDE.md (by number) OR all if no number.

tools.name: get_vocab
tools.description: Read shared prop-vocabulary type (`SizeProp`, `StatusProp`, `ColorProp`, `LoadingProp`, etc.) OR all if no name.

tools.name: get_tokens
tools.description: Read design tokens, optionally filtered by tier category (primitive / semantic / component).

tools.name: list_consumer_skills
tools.description: List the design skills relevant to an app-dev BUILDING WITH @godxjp/ui (audience consumer/both). Hides core library-maintenance skills. START HERE if you import @godxjp/ui and want guidance (design-to-page, compose-a-screen, taste, …). Returns id + name + whenToUse + section ids.

tools.name: get_consumer_skill
tools.description: Fetch ONE section of ONE consumer-facing skill. Same as get_skill_section but refuses core-only skills (steers app-devs away from library-maintenance material). Use after list_consumer_skills / route_consumer_task.

tools.name: route_consumer_task
tools.description: Natural-language task → consumer skill+section pointer. Like route_task but only points to consumer-facing skills (never core library-maintenance). Use FIRST when you're building an app with @godxjp/ui.

task.description: Describe what you want to build.

tools.name: draft_bug_report
tools.description: When @godxjp/ui ITSELF is at fault (missing token, a primitive lacking the controlled-vocabulary prop, a real a11y/behaviour bug, a wrong catalog example) and you cannot follow a rule — DON'T fake a workaround. This drafts a detailed GitHub issue body + a copy-paste `gh issue create` command so you can report it. Prints the command only; never runs gh.

summary.description: One-line title of the bug / blocked rule.

repro.description: Minimal steps or code to reproduce.

component.description: Affected component name, if any (links to get_component).

rule.description: Cardinal rule number that can't be followed, if any.

tools.name: check_compatibility
tools.description: Report whether the @godxjp/ui version installed in the target project matches THIS catalog (which describes one release train). A mismatched minor means the props/tokens/patterns may describe a build they never installed (#140). Pass the installed version (`npm ls @godxjp/ui`); call it at the START of a consumer session.

version.description: Installed @godxjp/ui version in the target project, e.g. '16.10.0'. Omit to just read the catalog's own version + compatible range.

tools.name: route_task
tools.description: Natural-language task → skill+section pointer (e.g. 'design a premium agency hero' → soft/vibe-archetypes). Use FIRST when you don't know which skill applies.

task.description: Describe what you want to build.

tools.name: suggest_primitive
tools.description: Use case → primitive recommendation. E.g. 'confirm a destructive delete' → DangerZone pattern + Dialog suggestion.

tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Fuzzy-search primitives by name / tagline / prop. Returns ranked matches. Core only by default; pass tier="lab" or "all" to include the opt-in @godxjp/ui/lab components.

tier.description: Default "core". "lab" lists the opt-in `@godxjp/ui/lab` components (niche, kept and tested, not in the default context); "all" lists both.

tools.name: get_frame_coverage
tools.description: Verified preview-contract coverage for a component (issue #163). Answers 'is this state actually PROVEN?' — returns, per contract dimension (variants, tones, sizes, shapes, density, controlled/uncontrolled ownership, disabled/read-only/loading/empty/error/success, async retry/cancel/offline, responsive viewport matrix, RTL, long/localized content, keyboard/focus, accessible name/description/error, reduced motion / coarse touch), whether an EXECUTED case proves it (covered), whether nothing proves it (UNTESTED), or whether it cannot exist (not-applicable, with a reason). UNTESTED IS NOT A PASS:

name.description: Public export name (e.g. 'Button', 'DataTable', 'CardFooter'). Omit for the repo-wide coverage summary.

tools.name: get_design
tools.description: DESIGN.md — the visual spec for screens built with @godxjp/ui: real tokens (YAML front matter), colour scarcity rules, typography, layout & density, elevation, components, ADMIN SCREEN ANATOMY (list / detail / form / settings / dashboard / approval queue), do's and don'ts, responsive, iteration guide, known gaps. Read before composing a screen. Pass `section` for one section; omit it for the whole document (~12 KB).

section.description: Section id or heading word, e.g. 'tokens', 'colors', 'admin-screen-anatomy', 'dos-and-donts', 'iteration-guide'. Unknown ids list the valid ones.

tools.name: get_exemplar
tools.description: A reference screen to match for an admin archetype: its anatomy notes from DESIGN.md, the full source of the showcase built from real @godxjp/ui primitives, and its live preview URL for screenshot comparison. Archetypes: list, detail, editor, reader, settings, dashboard, approval-queue. Omit `archetype` to list them.

archetype.description: list | detail | editor | reader | settings | dashboard | approval-queue (aliases: index, table, crud, collection, 一覧, record, show, master-detail, 詳細, form, edit, create, document-editor, record-editor, 編集, document, article, wiki, view, read, 閲覧, manual, documentation, docs, help, help-center, user-guide, legal, terms, privacy, マニュアル, 利用規約, preferences, account, 設定, overview, home, kpi, ダッシュボード, approval, queue, inbox, review, 承認).

tools.name: lint_jsx
tools.description: Heuristic check of a JSX snippet for common violations — raw `<button>` / `<input>`, `color='error'` on Tag/Badge, missing aria-label, missing source.code override on stories with cell renderers (rule 34), etc.

tools.name: verify_dossier
tools.description: Security verification - Verify integrity (checksum) and authenticity (signature) of a dossier. Returns pass/fail with stage details.

tools.name: read_dossier
tools.description: Read and parse a dossier file. Returns metadata and content. Should be called AFTER verify_dossier passes.

dry_run.description: Also return dry_run_plan: a STATIC preview (files, commands, network, env, risk_score 0-100) derived from the dossier's declared metadata and code blocks. The executing agent may take other actions; the score is a heuristic, not a safety guarantee.

tools.name: list_dossiers
tools.description: Discover available dossiers in a directory. Scans for *.ds.md files and returns metadata.

path.description: Directory to search (default: current working directory)

tools.name: search_dossiers
tools.description: Search the dossier registry for available dossiers by keyword. Returns matching dossiers with metadata.

category.description: Filter by category (devops, database, development, security, etc.)

tools.name: resolve_graph
tools.description: Resolve a dossier dependency graph into an execution plan. Reads relationships (preceded_by, followed_by, conflicts_with) and produces a DAG with ordered phases, parallel groups, and conflict detection.

dossier.description: Path to dossier file (.ds.md) or registry name

tools.name: verify_graph
tools.description: Batch security verification for a dossier dependency graph. Verifies all dossiers in a resolved graph and returns an aggregate security report with per-dossier breakdown and overall recommendation.

graph_id.description: ID of a previously resolved graph (from resolve_graph)

dossier.description: Path to dossier file (.ds.md) or registry name. Resolves and verifies in one shot.

tools.name: start_journey
tools.description: Start a journey session from a resolved and verified graph. Creates a session, returns the first step's dossier content with any injected context. Call step_complete after executing each step. With dry_run: true, creates no session and instead returns a static per-step preview (files, commands, network, env, risk score).

graph_id.description: ID of a previously resolved graph (from resolve_graph)

dry_run.description: Preview only: no session is created. Returns a STATIC preview derived from each dossier's declared metadata and code blocks; the executing agent may take other actions, and the risk score is a heuristic, not a safety guarantee.

tools.name: step_complete
tools.description: Mark the current journey step as complete or failed. Advances to the next step and returns its dossier content with injected context from previous outputs. Returns a summary when the last step completes or a step fails.

outputs.description: Key-value outputs collected during this step (e.g. { cluster_arn: "arn:..." })

status.description: Whether this step succeeded or failed

tools.name: get_journey_status
tools.description: Get the current state of a journey session: completed steps, current step, remaining steps, and collected outputs.

tools.name: cancel_journey
tools.description: Cancel an active journey session. Returns a summary of what completed before cancellation.
